<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Gravix — The Operating System for Modern Commerce</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Gravix is the premium enterprise ecommerce platform trusted by 10,000+ brands. AI-powered, infinitely scalable, beautifully designed." />
  <meta property="og:title" content="Gravix — The Operating System for Modern Commerce" />
  <meta property="og:description" content="The most powerful ecommerce platform ever built. Enterprise-grade infrastructure with consumer-grade simplicity." />
  <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    /* ============================================================
       DESIGN TOKENS
    ============================================================ */
    :root {
      --bg:              #08080E;
      --bg-deep:         #050508;
      --card:            #0F0F1A;
      --card-raised:     #141422;
      --border:          rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
      --border-glow:     rgba(124,58,237,0.35);

      --primary:         #7C3AED;
      --primary-light:   #9D5AF5;
      --primary-dark:    #5B21B6;
      --secondary:       #8B5CF6;
      --accent:          #3B82F6;
      --cyan:            #06B6D4;
      --success:         #10B981;
      --warning:         #F59E0B;
      --danger:          #F43F5E;

      --grad-primary:    linear-gradient(135deg, #7C3AED 0%, #A855F7 50%, #3B82F6 100%);
      --grad-hero:       radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 50% at 50% -10%, rgba(124,58,237,0.3) 0%, transparent 70%);
      --grad-card:       linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.1) 0%, rgba(59,130,246,0.05) 100%);
      --grad-text:       linear-gradient(135deg, #fff 0%, #A855F7 50%, #3B82F6 100%);

      --text:            #FFFFFF;
      --text-muted:      #94A3B8;
      --text-faint:      #475569;

      --radius-sm:       8px;
      --radius-md:       14px;
      --radius-lg:       20px;
      --radius-xl:       28px;
      --radius-2xl:      40px;

      --shadow-sm:       0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      --shadow-md:       0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      --shadow-lg:       0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      --shadow-glow:     0 0 40px rgba(124,58,237,0.25), 0 0 80px rgba(124,58,237,0.1);
      --shadow-glow-sm:  0 0 20px rgba(124,58,237,0.2);

      --font-display:    'Syne', sans-serif;
      --font-body:       'Inter', sans-serif;
      --font-mono:       'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

      --transition:      all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
      --transition-slow: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       RESET & BASE
    ============================================================ */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    button { cursor: pointer; border: none; font-family: inherit; }

    /* ============================================================
       SCROLLBAR
    ============================================================ */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-deep); }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--primary-dark); border-radius: 3px; }

    /* ============================================================
       UTILITY CLASSES
    ============================================================ */
    .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
    .container--wide { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

    .grad-text {
      background: var(--grad-text);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .glass {
      background: rgba(15,15,26,0.7);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .section {
      padding: 120px 0;
    }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--primary-light);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
    }
    .section-label::before {
      content: '';
      display: inline-block;
      width: 20px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--grad-primary);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(32px);
      transition: opacity 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
    }
    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
    .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
    .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
    .reveal-delay-4 { transition-delay: 0.4s; }

    /* ============================================================
       BUTTONS
    ============================================================ */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      transition: var(--transition);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .btn::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0);
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .btn:hover::after { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--grad-primary);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow-sm), 0 4px 20px rgba(124,58,237,0.4);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow), 0 8px 30px rgba(124,58,237,0.5);
    }
    .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

    .btn-ghost {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .btn-lg {
      padding: 18px 36px;
      font-size: 16px;
      border-radius: 14px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       NAVBAR
    ============================================================ */
    .navbar {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      padding: 0 24px;
      transition: var(--transition-slow);
    }
    .navbar.scrolled {
      background: rgba(8,8,14,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(200%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(200%);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .navbar__inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 72px;
    }
    .navbar__logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    }
    .navbar__logo-mark {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
    }
    .navbar__nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .navbar__nav a {
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .navbar__nav a:hover { color: var(--text); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
    .navbar__actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .navbar__actions .btn {
      padding: 10px 20px;
      font-size: 14px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    /* Mobile nav toggle */
    .nav-toggle {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      background: none;
      padding: 8px;
    }
    .nav-toggle span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--text-muted);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       HERO
    ============================================================ */
    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding-top: 72px;
    }

    .hero__bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: var(--bg-deep);
      z-index: 0;
    }
    .hero__mesh {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 0%, rgba(124,58,237,0.25) 0%, transparent 65%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 40% at 85% 50%, rgba(59,130,246,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 30% 30% at 15% 70%, rgba(168,85,247,0.1) 0%, transparent 60%);
      z-index: 0;
    }

    /* Animated grid */
    .hero__grid {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 60px 60px;
      mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 80% at 50% 50%, black 40%, transparent 100%);
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .hero__content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 100px 24px 80px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero__left {}

    .hero__badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px 14px 6px 6px;
      background: rgba(124,58,237,0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.3);
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--primary-light);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      animation: fadeInDown 0.8s ease both;
    }
    .hero__badge-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--primary-light);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.8); }
    }

    .hero__headline {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(44px, 5.5vw, 76px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      animation: fadeInUp 0.9s ease 0.1s both;
    }

    .hero__sub {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      max-width: 480px;
      animation: fadeInUp 0.9s ease 0.2s both;
    }

    .hero__cta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      animation: fadeInUp 0.9s ease 0.3s both;
    }

    .hero__trust {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 48px;
      animation: fadeInUp 0.9s ease 0.4s both;
    }
    .hero__avatars {
      display: flex;
    }
    .hero__avatar {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--bg);
      margin-left: -8px;
      background: var(--grad-primary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
    }
    .hero__avatar:first-child { margin-left: 0; }
    .hero__trust-text { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .hero__trust-text strong { color: var(--text); }

    .hero__right {
      position: relative;
      animation: fadeInRight 1s ease 0.3s both;
    }

    /* Dashboard Preview Card */
    .hero__preview {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), var(--shadow-glow);
      animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px) rotate(0deg); }
      33% { transform: translateY(-12px) rotate(0.5deg); }
      66% { transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
    }

    .hero__preview-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--card-raised);
    }
    .hero__preview-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .hero__preview-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .hero__preview-dot:nth-child(1) { background: #F43F5E; }
    .hero__preview-dot:nth-child(2) { background: #F59E0B; }
    .hero__preview-dot:nth-child(3) { background: #10B981; }
    .hero__preview-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .hero__preview-body {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .preview-kpis {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .preview-kpi {
      padding: 14px;
      background: var(--card-raised);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .preview-kpi__label {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      font-weight: 500;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .preview-kpi__value {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .preview-kpi__change {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--success);
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .preview-chart {
      background: var(--card-raised);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .preview-chart__label {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .mini-chart {
      width: 100%;
      height: 60px;
    }

    .preview-orders {
      background: var(--card-raised);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 12px;
    }
    .preview-order-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 8px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-size: 11px;
    }
    .preview-order-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .preview-order-info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .preview-order-avatar {
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--grad-primary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
    }
    .preview-order-name { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .preview-order-amount { color: var(--text); font-weight: 700; }
    .preview-order-badge {
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .badge-success { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15); color: var(--success); }
    .badge-warning { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.15); color: var(--warning); }

    /* Floating cards */
    .hero__float-card {
      position: absolute;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      background: rgba(15,15,26,0.9);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .hero__float-1 {
      top: -20px;
      left: -40px;
      animation: float 5s ease-in-out 0.5s infinite;
    }
    .hero__float-2 {
      bottom: 20px;
      right: -30px;
      animation: float 5.5s ease-in-out 1s infinite;
    }

    .float-card-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--grad-primary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       STATS BAR
    ============================================================ */
    .stats-bar {
      background: var(--card);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 40px 0;
    }
    .stats-bar__inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
    }
    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 24px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .stat-item:last-child { border-right: none; }
    .stat-item__value {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 40px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      background: var(--grad-primary);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }
    .stat-item__label {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       TRUSTED BY MARQUEE
    ============================================================ */
    .trusted {
      padding: 80px 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .trusted__label {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .marquee-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, black 10%, black 90%, transparent 100%);
    }
    .marquee-inner {
      display: flex;
      gap: 60px;
      animation: marquee 30s linear infinite;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .marquee-inner:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }
    @keyframes marquee {
      from { transform: translateX(0); }
      to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }
    .brand-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      white-space: nowrap;
      opacity: 0.5;
      transition: var(--transition);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }
    .brand-logo:hover { opacity: 0.8; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .brand-logo svg { flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* ============================================================
       FEATURES
    ============================================================ */
    .features {
      padding: 120px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg) 0%, var(--bg-deep) 50%, var(--bg) 100%);
    }
    .features__header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto 80px;
    }
    .features__header .section-subtitle { margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }

    .features__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      padding: 32px;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: var(--transition);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .feature-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: var(--grad-card);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s;
    }
    .feature-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-glow);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md), var(--shadow-glow-sm);
    }
    .feature-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }

    .feature-card--large {
      grid-column: span 2;
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: rgba(124,58,237,0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.25);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      color: var(--primary-light);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .feature-card h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }
    .feature-card p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.7;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .feature-card__tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-top: 20px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .tag-ai { background: rgba(168,85,247,0.15); color: #A855F7; border: 1px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.2); }
    .tag-new { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15); color: var(--success); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.2); }
    .tag-pro { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15); color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.2); }

    /* ============================================================
       AI BUILDER SECTION
    ============================================================ */
    .ai-section {
      padding: 120px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .ai-section::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 600px;
      height: 600px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(124,58,237,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      left: -200px;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .ai-section__inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .ai-section__window {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .ai-section__window-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 20px;
      background: var(--card-raised);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .ai-chat {
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .ai-message {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }
    .ai-message--user {
      flex-direction: row-reverse;
    }
    .ai-message__avatar {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .avatar-ai { background: var(--grad-primary); color: white; }
    .avatar-user { background: var(--card-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); }
    .ai-message__bubble {
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 80%;
    }
    .bubble-ai { background: var(--card-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); }
    .bubble-user { background: rgba(124,58,237,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.3); color: var(--text); }
    .ai-typing {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      background: var(--card-raised);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      width: fit-content;
    }
    .ai-typing span {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--primary-light);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: typing 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .ai-typing span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
    .ai-typing span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
    @keyframes typing {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-4px); }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       ANALYTICS SECTION
    ============================================================ */
    .analytics-section {
      padding: 120px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-deep) 0%, var(--bg) 100%);
    }
    .analytics-section__inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .analytics-preview {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 28px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .analytics-preview__header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .analytics-preview__title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .analytics-preview__range {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .range-btn {
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .range-btn.active {
      background: rgba(124,58,237,0.2);
      color: var(--primary-light);
    }
    .analytics-chart-wrap {
      position: relative;
      height: 200px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .analytics-bottom {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .analytics-stat {
      padding: 12px;
      background: var(--card-raised);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .analytics-stat__label {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .analytics-stat__value {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .analytics-stat__trend {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--success);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       INTEGRATIONS
    ============================================================ */
    .integrations {
      padding: 120px 0;
    }
    .integrations__header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto 72px;
    }
    .integrations__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .integration-card {
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 20px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      transition: var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .integration-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-glow);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md), var(--shadow-glow-sm);
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .integration-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       SECURITY
    ============================================================ */
    .security {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--bg-deep);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .security::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 800px;
      height: 800px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(59,130,246,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      right: -300px;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .security__inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .security__badges {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .security-badge {
      padding: 24px;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .security-badge:hover {
      border-color: rgba(59,130,246,0.3);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .security-badge__icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: rgba(59,130,246,0.1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .security-badge h4 {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
    }
    .security-badge p {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PRICING
    ============================================================ */
    .pricing {
      padding: 120px 0;
    }
    .pricing__header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto 72px;
    }
    .pricing__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .pricing-card {
      padding: 36px 32px;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      position: relative;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .pricing-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }
    .pricing-card--featured {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.15) 0%, rgba(59,130,246,0.08) 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.4);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow-sm);
    }
    .pricing-card--featured:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow), var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .pricing-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: -14px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--grad-primary);
      color: white;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 4px 16px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .pricing-tier {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .pricing-price {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .pricing-price__amount {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 52px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .pricing-price__amount--grad {
      background: var(--grad-primary);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }
    .pricing-price__period {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      font-weight: 400;
    }
    .pricing-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .pricing-divider {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--border);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .pricing-features {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .pricing-features li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .check-icon {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--success);
    }
    .pricing-card .btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }

    /* ============================================================
       TESTIMONIALS
    ============================================================ */
    .testimonials {
      padding: 120px 0;
      background: var(--bg-deep);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .testimonials__header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto 72px;
    }
    .testimonials__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .testimonial-card {
      padding: 32px;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-glow);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md), var(--shadow-glow-sm);
    }
    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .star { color: var(--warning); font-size: 14px; }
    .testimonial-quote {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.7;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding-top: 16px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .author-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--grad-primary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .author-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .author-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
    .author-role { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-faint); }

    /* ============================================================
       FAQ
    ============================================================ */
    .faq {
      padding: 120px 0;
    }
    .faq__inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .faq__list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0;
    }
    .faq-item {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .faq-item:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .faq-question {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 20px 0;
      background: none;
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-align: left;
      gap: 16px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .faq-question:hover { color: var(--primary-light); }
    .faq-chevron {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: var(--transition);
      color: var(--text-faint);
    }
    .faq-item.open .faq-chevron {
      background: rgba(124,58,237,0.15);
      border-color: rgba(124,58,237,0.3);
      color: var(--primary-light);
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }
    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), padding 0.3s;
    }
    .faq-answer.open { max-height: 300px; }
    .faq-answer p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.7;
      padding-bottom: 20px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       API SECTION
    ============================================================ */
    .api-section {
      padding: 120px 0;
      background: var(--bg-deep);
    }
    .api-section__inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .code-window {
      background: #0D1117;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .code-window__header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 14px 20px;
      background: #161B22;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }
    .code-window__title { font-size: 13px; color: #8B949E; font-weight: 500; }
    .code-window__lang {
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 2px 10px;
      background: rgba(124,58,237,0.2);
      color: var(--primary-light);
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .code-window pre {
      padding: 24px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      overflow-x: auto;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .code-kw { color: #FF7B72; }
    .code-fn { color: #D2A8FF; }
    .code-str { color: #A5D6FF; }
    .code-prop { color: #79C0FF; }
    .code-num { color: #F0883E; }
    .code-cm { color: #8B949E; }
    .code-punct { color: #E6EDF3; }

    .api-features {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }
    .api-feature {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .api-feature__icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: rgba(59,130,246,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.2);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--accent);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .api-feature h4 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .api-feature p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ============================================================
       CTA BANNER
    ============================================================ */
    .cta-banner {
      padding: 100px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cta-banner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: var(--grad-primary);
      opacity: 0.07;
    }
    .cta-banner__inner {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
    }
    .cta-banner__glow {
      position: absolute;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(124,58,237,0.2) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .cta-banner h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 56px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .cta-banner p {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .cta-banner__actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================================ */
    .footer {
      background: var(--bg-deep);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 80px 0 40px;
    }
    .footer__top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }
    .footer__brand {}
    .footer__brand-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer__tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .footer__social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .footer__social-link {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .footer__social-link:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-glow);
      color: var(--primary-light);
      background: rgba(124,58,237,0.1);
    }
    .footer__col-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .footer__links {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer__links a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .footer__links a:hover { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .footer__bottom {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding-top: 32px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .footer__copy { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-faint); }
    .footer__legal {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .footer__legal a {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-faint);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .footer__legal a:hover { color: var(--text-muted); }

    /* ============================================================
       KEYFRAMES
    ============================================================ */
    @keyframes fadeInDown {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-16px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    @keyframes fadeInUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    @keyframes fadeInRight {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(40px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
    }
    @keyframes countUp {
      from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       RESPONSIVE
    ============================================================ */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .hero__content { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 60px; }
      .hero__right { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; }
      .features__grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .feature-card--large { grid-column: span 1; }
      .ai-section__inner, .analytics-section__inner,
      .security__inner, .api-section__inner, .faq__inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 60px; }
      .integrations__grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
      .stats-bar__inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .stat-item { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 20px; }
      .footer__top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }

  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
  <script>
    /* ----------------------------------------
       NAVBAR SCROLL EFFECT
    ---------------------------------------- */
    const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (window.scrollY > 40) {
        navbar.classList.add('scrolled');
      } else {
        navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    /* ----------------------------------------
       REVEAL ON SCROLL
    ---------------------------------------- */
    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' });

    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

    /* ----------------------------------------
       ANIMATED COUNTERS
    ---------------------------------------- */
    function animateCounter(el, end, suffix, prefix, decimals) {
      let start = 0;
      const duration = 2200;
      const startTime = performance.now();

      function update(currentTime) {
        const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
        const current = start + (end - start) * ease;
        el.textContent = (prefix || '') + (decimals ? current.toFixed(decimals) : Math.floor(current).toLocaleString()) + (suffix || '');
        if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(update);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }

    const statsObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          const gmv = document.getElementById('stat-gmv');
          const brands = document.getElementById('stat-brands');
          const uptime = document.getElementById('stat-uptime');
          const countries = document.getElementById('stat-countries');
          if (gmv) animateCounter(gmv, 48, 'B+', '$');
          if (brands) animateCounter(brands, 10000, '+');
          if (uptime) animateCounter(uptime, 99.99, '%', '', 2);
          if (countries) animateCounter(countries, 180, '+');
          statsObserver.disconnect();
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.5 });

    const statsBar = document.querySelector('.stats-bar');
    if (statsBar) statsObserver.observe(statsBar);

    /* ----------------------------------------
       HERO MINI CHART
    ---------------------------------------- */
    const heroCtx = document.getElementById('heroMiniChart');
    if (heroCtx) {
      new Chart(heroCtx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
          labels: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'],
          datasets: [{
            data: [82000, 95000, 87000, 112000, 128000, 139000, 128430],
            borderColor: '#A855F7',
            borderWidth: 2,
            fill: true,
            backgroundColor: (ctx) => {
              const canvas = ctx.chart.canvas;
              const gradient = canvas.getContext('2d').createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 60);
              gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(168,85,247,0.3)');
              gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(168,85,247,0)');
              return gradient;
            },
            tension: 0.4,
            pointRadius: 0,
            pointHoverRadius: 4,
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: {
            backgroundColor: '#141422',
            titleColor: '#94A3B8',
            bodyColor: '#fff',
            borderColor: 'rgba(124,58,237,0.3)',
            borderWidth: 1,
            callbacks: {
              label: (ctx) => ' $' + ctx.raw.toLocaleString()
            }
          }},
          scales: {
            x: { display: false },
            y: { display: false }
          },
          animation: { duration: 1500, easing: 'easeInOutQuart' }
        }
      });
    }

    /* ----------------------------------------
       ANALYTICS CHART
    ---------------------------------------- */
    const analyticsCtx = document.getElementById('analyticsChart');
    if (analyticsCtx) {
      const analyticsChart = new Chart(analyticsCtx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
          labels: Array.from({length: 30}, (_, i) => `Day ${i + 1}`),
          datasets: [{
            label: 'Revenue',
            data: [42000,55000,48000,62000,58000,71000,69000,80000,75000,90000,85000,98000,92000,105000,110000,102000,118000,125000,121000,135000,140000,132000,148000,155000,162000,158000,170000,178000,185000,192000],
            borderColor: '#A855F7',
            borderWidth: 2.5,
            fill: true,
            backgroundColor: (ctx) => {
              const gradient = ctx.chart.canvas.getContext('2d').createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 200);
              gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(168,85,247,0.2)');
              gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(168,85,247,0)');
              return gradient;
            },
            tension: 0.4,
            pointRadius: 0,
            pointHoverRadius: 5,
            pointHoverBackgroundColor: '#A855F7',
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: {
            legend: { display: false },
            tooltip: {
              backgroundColor: '#141422',
              titleColor: '#94A3B8',
              bodyColor: '#fff',
              borderColor: 'rgba(124,58,237,0.3)',
              borderWidth: 1,
              callbacks: {
                title: () => 'Revenue',
                label: (ctx) => ' $' + ctx.raw.toLocaleString()
              }
            }
          },
          scales: {
            x: {
              display: true,
              grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)', drawBorder: false },
              ticks: { color: '#475569', font: { size: 10, family: 'Inter' }, maxTicksLimit: 6 },
              border: { display: false }
            },
            y: {
              display: true,
              grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)', drawBorder: false },
              ticks: {
                color: '#475569', font: { size: 10, family: 'Inter' },
                callback: v => '$' + (v >= 1000 ? (v/1000).toFixed(0) + 'k' : v)
              },
              border: { display: false }
            }
          },
          interaction: { intersect: false, mode: 'index' }
        }
      });

      // Range buttons
      document.querySelectorAll('.range-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          document.querySelectorAll('.range-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
          btn.classList.add('active');
        });
      });
    }

    /* ----------------------------------------
       FAQ ACCORDION
    ---------------------------------------- */
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const item = btn.parentElement;
        const answer = item.querySelector('.faq-answer');
        const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');

        // Close all
        document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(i => {
          i.classList.remove('open');
          i.querySelector('.faq-answer').classList.remove('open');
          i.querySelector('.faq-question').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });

        // Open clicked if it was closed
        if (!isOpen) {
          item.classList.add('open');
          answer.classList.add('open');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }
      });
    });

    /* ----------------------------------------
       SMOOTH SCROLL FOR ANCHOR LINKS
    ---------------------------------------- */
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a => {
      a.addEventListener('click', e => {
        const target = document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault();
          target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        }
      });
    });
